facts.text: Dessert is on me tonight. Built it myself, so yes, it is probably the best one in the room.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Tony's words, but he never says it. It is not on the Wikiquote page for the film.

facts.text: Tony's chlorophyll fix, minus the palladium.
facts.why: The transcript has Tony being asked what he drank and answering chlorophyll, so the green drink fits alongside the palladium poisoning.

facts.text: Serve dessert when Tony sits in the giant doughnut sign and Fury turns up.
facts.why: After the birthday party fight Tony ends up in the Randy's Donuts scene and Nick Fury approaches him. Fits.

vibe.verdict: Good Expo setting and a strong doughnut hook, though the writing is mostly plain and misses the villain's side of the film.
